purpose: Purposive diagnostic corpus for residual-cause review; not a probability sample, holdout, accuracy evaluation, or ground truth.

snapshot.database: existing local Career OS PostgreSQL container; role/read-only snapshot
snapshot.transaction: one SELECT returning metadata/source roster/current posting inputs; explicit COMMIT before offline classification/selection
snapshot.source_roster_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators(",", ":"); source rows sorted by source_key; fields source_key,kind,enabled

provenance.canonical_input_format: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators(",", ":"); allow_nan=false; array sorted by ascending (source_key, external_id, job_id); fields job_id,source_key,external_id,enabled,status,title,description

selection_rule.selection_key: sha256(UTF8("career-radar-p4-residual-cause-v1" + U+001F + stratum_id + U+001F + lexical_prefix_or_empty + U+001F + job_id)); ascending digest, then source_key, external_id, job_id
selection_rule.unknown_scope: Count current classifier 1.1.0 unknown_scope rows by casefolded Unicode regex \w+ tokens after removing only repeated leading seniority tokens {senior,sr,staff,principal,lead,junior,jr,mid,intern}; rank buckets by descending population then lexical key; choose the first 8 buckets and 5 rows per bucket by selection key.
selection_rule.technical_unclassified: Eligible current classifier 1.1.0 unclassified/in_scope rows with no line matching the classifier explicit duty heading regex; choose 40 by selection key. This stratum excludes all explicit-duty-heading rows.
selection_rule.explicit_heading_census: Include every unclassified row matching _GENERIC_ENGINEERING_HEAD and containing at least one explicit duty heading, provided no family duty pattern is recognized. Preserve parser subtypes: heading with zero extracted bullets; extracted bullets with no family match.
selection_rule.conflicts: Include every current classifier 1.1.0 conflict row.
selection_rule.deduplication: Distinct posting IDs required across this corpus. No reference corpus rows are excluded from selection; record ID, normalized-title, and two-token-prefix overlaps separately against preflight75, retained golden rows, and frozen40. Within-corpus normalized-title and two-token-prefix duplicate groups are reported.
selection_rule.normalized_title_for_overlap: NFKC; casefold; normalize listed Unicode dash forms to ASCII hyphen; collapse whitespace; preserve punctuation.
selection_rule.two_token_prefix_for_overlap: Casefold; Unicode \w+ tokenization; remove only leading seniority tokens from the listed set; first two remaining tokens, or all remaining if fewer than two. This is a lexical overlap key, not an adjudicated role head.
selection_rule.limitations: Purposive diagnostic corpus only; labels do not estimate accuracy, prevalence, trends, or achievable coverage. No software-engineer family inference from title context.
